evidence: Codex CLI 0.147.0 rejected --ask-for-approval after the exec subcommand; no model call occurred. The installed help showed that exec accepts config overrides, so approval_policy=never was used instead.

The managed filesystem denied Codex writes to ~/.codex/state_5.sqlite, so the in-process app-server client did not initialize and no model call occurred. The same command was rerun with approved host access.
